cover_headline: India's First Bullet Train to Run in Last Quarter of 2027, Surat-Vapi First
facts: India's first high-speed rail service will commence in the last quarter of 2027, with the Surat-Vapi section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor opening first
As of September, 456 km of pier work and 371 km of viaduct construction have been completed on the 508 km corridor
The indigenous B28 trainset is designed for 280 kmph, and track trials are expected by mid-2027

end.headline: India's First Bullet Train to Run in Last Quarter of 2027, Surat-Vapi First
end.line: The Surat-Vapi section opens first in the last quarter of 2027, with the full Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor following in phases and no fares or booking details announced yet.
